title: Numbers 13: The Spies Search the Land
body:
Read the chapter → [Numbers 13](/bible/numbers/13)

**[Numbers 13:1-16](/bible/numbers/13#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/numbers/13#v1)</sup> And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/numbers/13#v2)</sup> Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/numbers/13#v3)</sup> And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/numbers/13#v4)</sup> And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/numbers/13#v5)</sup> Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/numbers/13#v6)</sup> Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/numbers/13#v7)</sup> Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/numbers/13#v8)</sup> Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/numbers/13#v9)</sup> Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/numbers/13#v10)</sup> Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/numbers/13#v11)</sup> Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/numbers/13#v12)</sup> Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/numbers/13#v13)</sup> Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/numbers/13#v14)</sup> Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/numbers/13#v15)</sup> Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/numbers/13#v16)</sup> These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

- The Lord told Moses to send men to search the land of Canaan, one ruler of every tribe of their fathers. Among them were Caleb the son of Jephunneh of the tribe of Judah, and Oshea the son of Nun, whom Moses called Jehoshua, that is Joshua.
- Sending out spies to learn the landscape, the people, and their strength is the wisdom of war; Moses had learned such things as a leader in Egypt.

**[Numbers 13:17-25](/bible/numbers/13#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/numbers/13#v17)</sup> And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/numbers/13#v18)</sup> And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/numbers/13#v19)</sup> And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/numbers/13#v20)</sup> And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/numbers/13#v21)</sup> So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/numbers/13#v22)</sup> And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/numbers/13#v23)</sup> And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/numbers/13#v24)</sup> The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/numbers/13#v25)</sup> And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

- Moses sent them up to see the land, whether the people were strong or weak, few or many, the cities open or walled, the land fat or lean; and they searched it forty days.
- They came to the brook of Eshcol and cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes, and bare it between two upon a staff. The cluster was so great it took two men to carry it, for the earth was younger then and brought forth greater stature in its fruit and its men.

  Precepts:
  - **[2 Esdras 5:52-55](/bible/2-esdras/5#v52)**
    > <sup>[52](/bible/2-esdras/5#v52)</sup> Say unto her, Wherefore are unto they whom thou hast now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?
    >
    > <sup>[53](/bible/2-esdras/5#v53)</sup> And she shall answer thee, They that be born in the the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb faileth, are otherwise.
    >
    > <sup>[54](/bible/2-esdras/5#v54)</sup> Consider thou therefore also, how that ye are less of stature than those that were before you.
    >
    > <sup>[55](/bible/2-esdras/5#v55)</sup> And so are they that come after you less than ye, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.

    The earth in its youth brought forth greater stature, and each generation since is less than the one before.

**[Numbers 13:26-33](/bible/numbers/13#v26)**

> <sup>[26](/bible/numbers/13#v26)</sup> And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/numbers/13#v27)</sup> And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/numbers/13#v28)</sup> Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
>
> <sup>[29](/bible/numbers/13#v29)</sup> The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
>
> <sup>[30](/bible/numbers/13#v30)</sup> And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
>
> <sup>[31](/bible/numbers/13#v31)</sup> But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
>
> <sup>[32](/bible/numbers/13#v32)</sup> And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
>
> <sup>[33](/bible/numbers/13#v33)</sup> And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

- They returned and reported the land floweth with milk and honey, and showed the fruit; nevertheless the people be strong, the cities walled and very great, and the children of Anak were there. Caleb stilled the people and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
- But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we; and they brought up an evil report, calling it a land that eateth up the inhabitants, where they saw the giants, the sons of Anak, and were in their own sight as grasshoppers.
- The Lord had willed them to go up, but these men were so out of the spirit that they forgot He had already destroyed mightier nations before them. An evil report spreads a spirit of fear, but the Most High has not given His people the spirit of fear.

  Precepts:
  - **[2 Timothy 1:7](/bible/2-timothy/1#v7)**
    > <sup>[7](/bible/2-timothy/1#v7)</sup> For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

    For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
  - **[Baruch 3:26-28](/bible/baruch/3#v26)**
    > <sup>[26](/bible/baruch/3#v26)</sup> There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.
    >
    > <sup>[27](/bible/baruch/3#v27)</sup> Those did not the Lord choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge unto them:
    >
    > <sup>[28](/bible/baruch/3#v28)</sup> But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.

    The giants were men of great stature, famous from the beginning, yet destroyed because they had no wisdom.
  - **[1 Maccabees 3:56](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v56)**
    > <sup>[56](/bible/1-maccabees/3#v56)</sup> But as for such as were building houses, or had betrothed wives, or were planting vineyards, or were fearful, those he commanded that they should return, every man to his own house, according to the law.

    By the law of war the fearful were sent back home, lest they put their fear upon the other men.
